title: Modal workspace access
description: The artifact epack-collector-modal emits at artifacts/modal.details.json: who can reach a Modal workspace, and what the workspace exposes through its tokens, secrets, and apps. A value the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result records a gap for it. The collector checks its output against this schema when it emits.

schema_version.x-epack-summary: The version of this artifact's format.

collected_at_level.description: The collection level the artifact was made at. audit adds the inventories to trust's counts, and internal adds nothing more.
collected_at_level.x-epack-summary: The detail level this artifact was collected at. It is trust, audit, or internal.

workspace.description: The workspace the token belongs to.
workspace.x-epack-summary: The Modal workspace the API token belongs to.

members.description: The workspace's members. Reading them needs a token that belongs to the workspace's Owner or a Manager. With any other token, or when the list fails, they are left out with a gap.
members.x-epack-summary: The people in the workspace. Collected only when the API token belongs to the workspace's Owner or a Manager.

total_count.x-epack-method: Lists the workspace's members and counts each one without a deletion time.

owner_count.x-epack-summary: Members with the Owner role, which has full access to the workspace, including billing.
owner_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose workspace role is Owner.

manager_count.x-epack-summary: Members with the Manager role, which has the same access as the Owner but cannot change the Owner role.
manager_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose workspace role is Manager.

member_count.x-epack-summary: Members with the Member role, who can deploy and manage apps but cannot access billing or workspace settings.
member_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose workspace role is Member.

sign_in.description: Members counted by how they sign in.
sign_in.x-epack-summary: Members counted by how they sign in to Modal.

github_count.description: Members who sign in with GitHub.
github_count.x-epack-summary: Members who sign in with GitHub.
github_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose identity provider type is GitHub.

google_count.description: Members who sign in with Google.
google_count.x-epack-summary: Members who sign in with Google.
google_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose identity provider type is Google OAuth.

saml_count.description: Members who sign in through SAML SSO.
saml_count.x-epack-label: Members signing in with SAML SSO
saml_count.x-epack-summary: Members who sign in through SAML SSO.
saml_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose identity provider type is SAML.

other_count.description: Members who sign in some other way, or whose sign-in Modal does not report.
other_count.x-epack-summary: Members who sign in some other way, or whose sign-in method Modal does not report.
other_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose identity provider type is missing or is not GitHub, Google OAuth, or SAML.

inactive_count.description: Members with no activity in the 90 days before the collector ran, including members who have never been active. The collector's calls count as activity for the member the token belongs to, so that member is never inactive.
inactive_count.x-epack-summary: Members with no activity in the 90 days before the collection ran, including members who have never been active. The collector's calls count as activity for the member who owns the API token, so that member is never inactive.
inactive_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed members whose last activity time is missing or more than 90 days before the run.

email.description: The member's email address, in lowercase.
email.x-epack-summary: The member's email address, in lowercase.

role.description: The member's workspace role. other is a role this version of the collector does not know.
role.x-epack-summary: The member's role in the workspace, such as owner or manager. other covers any other role.

sign_in.x-epack-summary: How the member signs in, such as github or saml. other covers any other way, and members whose sign-in method Modal does not report.

joined_at.description: When the member joined the workspace. Null when the API does not say.
joined_at.x-epack-summary: When the member joined the workspace. Empty when Modal does not report it.

last_active_at.description: When the member was last active. Null for a member who has never been active.
last_active_at.x-epack-summary: When the member was last active. Empty for a member who has never been active.

inactive.description: Whether the member had no activity in the 90 days before the collector ran, or has never been active.
inactive.x-epack-summary: Whether the member had no activity in the 90 days before the collection ran, or has never been active.

environments.description: The environments the token can see. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed.

total_count.x-epack-summary: Environments the API token can see.

restricted_count.description: Environments with restricted access, where a member needs a role in the environment to use it.
restricted_count.x-epack-summary: Environments with restricted access. In a restricted environment, members other than the Owner and Managers get its default member role unless they hold a role of their own.
restricted_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed environments that have restricted access, from each one's is_managed flag.

inventory.description: Every environment the token can see, sorted by name.
inventory.x-epack-summary: Each environment the API token can see, sorted by name.

default.description: Whether this is the workspace's default environment.

created_at.description: When the environment was created. Null when the API does not say.
created_at.x-epack-summary: When the environment was created. Empty when Modal does not report it.

default_member_role.description: The role a member gets in a restricted environment when they hold no role of their own. other is a role this version of the collector does not know. Null when Modal reports none.
default_member_role.x-epack-summary: The role a member gets in a restricted environment when they hold no role of their own, such as viewer or no_access. other covers any other role. Empty when Modal reports none.

blocks_unauthenticated.description: Whether the environment rejects new web endpoints, servers, and tunnels that anyone can call without authentication.
blocks_unauthenticated.x-epack-summary: Whether new web endpoints, servers, and tunnels that need no authentication are blocked in the environment. Empty when the environment follows the workspace default, which Modal does not report.
